summary_claims.claim: Art. 9-B: duty to inform 'de modo explicito, destacado e acessivel que o conteudo foi fabricado ou manipulado e a tecnologia utilizada' (literal: explicitly, prominently and accessibly that the content was fabricated or manipulated and the technology used)

Art. 9-C para 1: ban on synthetic audio/video creating or altering image or voice of living, dead or fictitious person, 'ainda que mediante autorizacao' (even with authorisation); para 2: cassacao do registro ou do mandato
Art. 9-E: providers jointly and severally liable if they do not make content unavailable immediately in listed cases; the summary names only the AI-labelling case (item V), a narrowing but accurate
DJE-TSE no. 29 of 4.3.2024, pp. 132-145; Art. 6 in force on publication
